description_en: Attaches a child instance (VBR) to an Express Connect Router (ECR)
kebab_example: aliyun expressconnectrouter attach-express-connect-router-child-instance --ecr-id ecr-a5xqrgbeidz1w80000 --child-instance-id vbr-j6cwxhgg0s5nuephp0000 --child-instance-type VBR --child-instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECR instance
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual border router (VBR) instance
parameters.name: child_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the network instance. Set the value to VBR. VBR specifies a virtual border router
parameters.help_zh: 网络实例的类型，取值：VBR边界路由器
parameters.name: child_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The region where the VBR instance is located
parameters.name: child_instance_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the VBR instance belongs.

This parameter is required if you attach a network instance that belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
VBR实例所属的阿里云账号ID（主账号）。

如果您要加载跨账号的网络实例，本参数必填
parameters.name: child_instance_owner_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Performs a dry run to check the request without modifying service resources.

false (default): Sends the request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique parameter value from your client for each request. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The description of the child instance. The description must be 0 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 子实例的描述信息。长度为0～128个字符
parameters.name: description

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

Code.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of 200 indicates that the call was successful. Other values indicate that the call failed. For more information, see the "Error codes" section
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为 200 表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message that is used to replace the `%s` placeholder in the ErrMessage parameter.

For example, if the value of ErrMessage is The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and the value of DynamicMessage is DtsJobId, the specified DtsJobId parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

True: The call was successful.

False: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：

True：成功。
False：失败
